summary: End-to-end verification of the new 'Canlı Grup Eğitimleri' feature (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 13/13 pass on /app/backend/tests/test_group_trainings.py covering: public list/detail (seeded google-ads-canli-grup-egitimi has capacity=12, price=4999, remaining=12, low_stock=False, meet_link NOT exposed on public detail), admin CRUD with live capacity update, urgency toggle (capacity 20 -> low_stock False, 8 -> True, 50 -> False), admin students & meet-link exposure via /admin/group-trainings, unauth purchase -> 401, authed purchase against unconfigured PayTR -> 503 with Turkish 'Kart ile ödeme henüz yapılandırılmadı' detail, capacity enforcement (400 'kontenjan doldu' with sold_out=True + remaining=0 when full), cron POST /api/cron/group-reminders 401 without Bearer and 200 with the WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET, /my/group-trainings empty for a fresh user, and /my/group-trainings exposing meet_link once admin sets it. Frontend Playwright as admin: /canli-grup-egitimleri lists seeded card (group-card-<slug>), navbar link 'Canlı Grup Eğitimleri' present, detail page shows remaining='12 kişi' with group-urgency HIDDEN. Editing capacity to 8 via /yonetim/grup-egitimleri (add-group/edit-group-*/group-title/group-capacity/save-group all working) makes the public detail page instantly reflect remaining='8 kişi' AND show the group-urgency alarm badge with animate-pulse; restoring capacity to 12 hides it again. Clicking group-buy (logged in) triggered POST /api/group-trainings/:id/purchase, which returned 503 and produced a Turkish toast 'Kart ile ödeme henüz yapılandırılmadı...' — no crash, no Havale option shown. Student panel: after seeding a group_enrollment for the admin and setting a meet_link on lesson 1, /panel > tab-group renders the training card, the schedule and a working 'Katıl' button (meet-link-<lessonId> anchor href=https://meet.google.com/test-abc-xyz) for lesson 1 and 'Link yakında eklenecek' text for lesson 2. All test data cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_group.purchase_group inserts an 'orders' doc BEFORE PayTR credential check would matter — since the 503 raises earlier when creds are missing, no orphan is created in the unconfigured case; however when PayTR is configured but returns non-success, the 'pending' order is still left in the DB with no cleanup (same pattern noted for consulting). Consider marking it 'failed' or removing it on 502.

routes_group._public reads doc.lessons and returns meet_link only when with_links=True; but the seed lesson objects lack an 'id' when created via bulk seed vs API. The public endpoint returns id=None for those and the student-side meet-link data-testid becomes 'meet-link-None' if the id was ever missing. Verified admin-created lessons via API do get gl_* ids via _norm_lessons, so this is only a risk if lessons are ever inserted directly into mongo without going through the admin endpoint.

Cron endpoint kicks off asyncio.create_task(_run_reminders()) and returns 200 without any error capture; if _run_reminders() raises, the exception is swallowed silently (no logging). Consider wrapping in try/except with logging so failed cron runs are visible.
GroupDetail promo iframe uses toEmbed(g.promo_video); Vimeo's own 'Player error' shows in this env but that's an external-asset issue and expected per handoff note.

routes_group. _fmt uses datetime.fromisoformat on date_str which accepts ISO date; no timezone handling — reminder scheduler assumes lesson date/time are Turkey local; TR_now offset is hard-coded +3h. Fine for TR, but a subtle assumption to document.
